turns.prompt_text: how much is a GTX graphics processor
turns.response_html:
NVIDIA GTX series graphics cards, which have largely been succeeded by the RTX series, are currently positioned as entry-level components for 1080p gaming or compact PC builds. Depending on the specific model and whether you are buying new or used, prices typically range from $60 to $400.

Entry-Level GTX Cards

These models are designed for basic gaming and are the most affordable options in the current market. They typically feature 4GB of VRAM and are suitable for less demanding titles.

  • The PNY GeForce GTX 1650 is a budget-friendly option based on the Turing architecture. It is designed for low-profile or small form factor builds and provides stable 1080p performance.
  • The Asus TUF Gaming GeForce GTX 1630 serves as a very basic entry point. While it lacks the power of the 1650 or 1660 series, it is a highly power-efficient card for systems with limited PSU capacity.

Performance GTX Cards (1660 Series)

The GTX 1660 Super remains a popular choice for budget gamers because it offers 6GB of GDDR6 memory, which handles modern 1080p games much more effectively than the 1650 series.

  • The Asus NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 SUPER is a highly-rated model known for its Auto-Extreme manufacturing and effective cooling. It is capable of reaching 60fps at 1080p on many modern titles.
  • For a more premium build, the MSI GeForce GTX 1660 Super Gaming X features the Twin Frozr 7 cooling system, which allows the fans to stay off during light use for silent operation.

Price Summary & Recommendation

  • Used Market: You can often find used GTX 1650 cards for around $60–$85 and GTX 1660 Super cards for approximately $90–$120.
  • New Condition: Retail prices for new GTX cards are often inflated because they are older stock; for example, a new GTX 1660 Super can cost $240–$330.

At these price points, if you are buying new, you may want to consider newer entry-level cards like the RTX 5050 or AMD RX 9060 XT, which often offer significantly better performance for a similar investment.
